examples.en: She runs the meeting tightly — agenda out the day before, notes the same day.
examples.zh: 她主持会议很利落——议程提前一天发，纪要当天出。

situation.en: You run the meeting this week; I'll take notes.
situation.zh: 经理让你下周开始轮值主持站会。

entries.zh: 主持会议

examples.en: A good facilitator makes quiet people speak and loud people listen.
examples.zh: 好的主持人能让安静的人开口、让话多的人倾听。

situation.en: I'll facilitate; you focus on the technical questions.
situation.zh: 你被指派去引导一场容易吵起来的评审会。

entries.zh: 主持并引导（讨论、会议）

examples.en: Let's timebox the naming debate to ten minutes.
examples.zh: 命名之争咱们限时十分钟。

situation.en: Timebox this to fifteen minutes, then we vote and move on.
situation.zh: 讨论在一个小问题上无限拉长，你提议限时。

entries.zh: 给（议题、讨论）设定时间上限

examples.en: That's important but off-topic — put it in the parking lot.
examples.zh: 这个重要但跑题了——先放进停车场清单。

situation.en: We had six items in the parking lot; the follow-up call cleared them all.
situation.zh: 有人把话题带偏，你想不打断热情地先搁置。

entries.zh: （会议的）停车场：先记下、会后再议的话题清单

examples.en: We tabled the rebrand topic until the budget is confirmed.
examples.zh: 品牌改名这个议题被搁置了，等预算确认再说。

situation.en: Let's table this topic — the person who owns it isn't here.
situation.zh: 关键决策人不在场，你提议这个话题先放一放。

entries.zh: 搁置某个议题（以后再议）

examples.en: This affects only our two teams — let's take this offline.
examples.zh: 这事只关系到我们两个团队——会后私下聊吧。

situation.en: Take this offline and bring the conclusion back tomorrow.
situation.zh: 两个人在大会上争细节，你出面打断。

entries.zh: 会后私下再聊这个（别占用大家时间）

examples.en: We went off track into tooling preferences for twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 我们跑题聊了二十分钟的工具偏好。

situation.en: Sorry, I went off track — back to the launch plan.
situation.zh: 你自嘲刚才把大家带偏了，拉回来。

entries.zh: 跑题、偏离议程

examples.en: When the debate heats up, steer the discussion back to user impact.
examples.zh: 争论升温时，把讨论拉回到对用户的影响上。

situation.en: She steered the discussion from blame to root causes in minutes.
situation.zh: 你请一位资深同事帮忙控场。

entries.zh: 把讨论方向拉回来、引导讨论

examples.en: I'll open the floor for the last ten minutes — anything goes.
examples.zh: 最后十分钟开放发言——什么都可以问。

situation.en: Let's open the floor: who has the first question?
situation.zh: 你主持分享会，讲完后进入提问环节。

entries.zh: 开放发言、请大家自由提问

examples.en: Let's go around the room — one blocker each, thirty seconds.
examples.zh: 咱们轮流来——每人一个阻塞项，三十秒。

situation.en: Going around the room surfaced risks nobody had written down.
situation.zh: 人多时你想保证每个人都能说上话。

entries.zh: 轮流发言（一圈人依次说）

examples.en: Who's capturing action items today? Last time they evaporated.
examples.zh: 今天谁负责记行动项？上次记的全没人跟进。

situation.en: I'll capture action items and post them in the channel.
situation.zh: 你担心会上说的事又没人跟进。

entries.zh: （在纪要里）记录行动项

examples.en: Before we leave, let me recap the decisions so nobody walks out confused.
examples.zh: 散会之前，我把定下来的决定复述一遍，免得有人糊涂。

situation.en: Recap the decisions in the notes, in bold, at the top.
situation.zh: 会议结论有点散，你来做收尾确认。

entries.zh: 复述、汇总已定的决定

examples.en: Let's confirm next steps before people drop off.
examples.zh: 趁大家还没下线，把下一步确认了。

situation.en: Confirming next steps takes two minutes and saves two weeks.
situation.zh: 会开完了但事情还没落地，你赶紧钉死。

entries.zh: 确认下一步（动作和负责人）

examples.en: We won't settle this today — schedule a follow-up for Thursday.
examples.zh: 这事今天定不下来——约周四再开一次。

situation.en: I'll schedule a follow-up with the data team included.
situation.zh: 讨论超时了，你提议另约时间深挖。

entries.zh: 约一个后续会议

examples.en: That recurring meeting outlived its purpose months ago.
examples.zh: 那个例会几个月前就失去存在的意义了。

situation.en: Cancel the recurring meeting; the async update covers it.
situation.zh: 你想砍掉一个每周都开但没产出的会。

entries.zh: 例会、周期性会议

examples.en: An ad hoc meeting beat three days of message ping-pong.
examples.zh: 一次临时会胜过三天的消息来回。

situation.en: Grab whoever's free for an ad hoc meeting — this is blocking the release.
situation.zh: 问题在群里聊不清，你提议马上拉个会。

entries.zh: 临时会议、随约随开的会

examples.en: The CEO announced the reorg at the all-hands meeting.
examples.zh: CEO 在全员大会上宣布了组织调整。

situation.en: Questions for the all-hands meeting go in the shared doc first.
situation.zh: 你跟新同事解释那个每月一次的大会是什么。

entries.zh: 全员大会

examples.en: At the town hall, employees asked about the hiring freeze directly.
examples.zh: 在全员沟通会上，员工直接问了冻结招聘的事。

situation.en: The town hall is your chance to ask leadership anything.
situation.zh: 你想在有问答环节的大会上提一个敏感问题。

entries.zh: （公司领导与员工的）全员沟通会

examples.en: My skip-level meeting is monthly, and it's mostly me listening.
examples.zh: 我每月有一次跨级会议，大部分时间是我在听。

situation.en: Prepare two honest observations for the skip-level meeting.
situation.zh: 你跟朋友聊你明天要见大老板，有点紧张。

entries.zh: 跨级会议（和老板的老板开会）

examples.en: We split into breakout rooms of four to brainstorm, then reported back.
examples.zh: 我们分成四人一组的分组讨论室头脑风暴，然后回来汇报。

situation.en: Twenty minutes in the breakout room, then each group shares one idea.
situation.zh: 你组织线上工作坊，需要分组讨论环节。

entries.zh: （线上会议的）分组讨论室

examples.en: Can everyone see my screen? The font might be small.
examples.zh: 大家都能看到我的屏幕吗？字可能有点小。

situation.en: Before I start — can everyone see my screen okay?
situation.zh: 你刚共享完屏幕，不确定大家是不是看到了。

entries.zh: 大家都能看到我的屏幕吗

examples.en: The call dropped right as she was giving the final number.
examples.zh: 她刚要说最后的数字，通话就断了。

situation.en: Sorry, the call dropped on my end — where were we?
situation.zh: 你重新拨进来，先解释刚才为什么消失。

entries.zh: 通话断了、掉线了

examples.en: With this bad connection, let's switch cameras off.
examples.zh: 网络这么差，咱们把摄像头关了吧。

situation.en: Bad connection on my side — I'll type my update in the chat.
situation.zh: 线上会一直卡，你提议降级到纯音频。

entries.zh: 网络连接不好

examples.en: On calls we keep talking over each other — let's use the hand raise.
examples.zh: 电话会上我们老是抢话——用举手功能吧。

situation.en: Sorry, we talked over each other — you go first.
situation.zh: 线上讨论一热烈就乱，你提议立个规矩。

entries.zh: 抢话、同时说话互相盖

examples.en: One person dominated the conversation for the full hour.
examples.zh: 整整一个小时都是一个人在说话。

situation.en: Watch the clock so one voice doesn't dominate the conversation.
situation.zh: 你复盘会议时委婉指出主持方式的问题。

entries.zh: （一个人）主导了整个对话、别人插不上话

examples.en: When discussion stalls, take a vote and record the minority view.
examples.zh: 讨论僵住时就表决，并把少数派意见记录下来。

situation.en: Let's take a vote — winner ships, loser writes the doc.
situation.zh: 两个方案吵不出结果，你提议直接投票。

entries.zh: 投票表决

examples.en: A quick show of hands: who has shipped to production this week?
examples.zh: 快速举个手：这周谁上过生产？

situation.en: By a show of hands, most of the room preferred the simpler design.
situation.zh: 你想快速摸个底，不想点名。

entries.zh: 举手表决

examples.en: The vote is tied at four-four — as chair, you break the tie.
examples.zh: 投票四比四打平，技术负责人投了决定性的一票。

situation.en: As facilitator, you'll break the tie if it comes to that.
situation.zh: 你解释最后那个方案是怎么定下来的。

entries.zh: 打破平局、做决定性一票

examples.en: We deferred the decision until the load test numbers arrive.
examples.zh: 我们把决定推迟到压测数据出来之后。

situation.en: Defer the decision a week — deciding wrong now costs more.
situation.zh: 证据不足时你不赞成硬拍板。

entries.zh: 把决定推迟（到信息更全时）

examples.en: I'll own the follow-up with legal and report back Friday.
examples.zh: 我来负责跟进法务那边，周五回报。

situation.en: Who owns the follow-up on the vendor contract?
situation.zh: 会上事情定完了，你主动认领后续跟进。

entries.zh: 负责跟进（某件事的后续）
